source.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US)
source.delivery: Direct Federal Reserve H.10 country historical pages
source.price_type: Noon buying rates in New York City for cable transfers payable in foreign currencies
source.role: Historical FX target/return labels only; never used as a predictor feature in this experiment
source.transport_change_note: The initially frozen FRED transport timed out in GitHub Actions before any edge result was computed. Delivery was therefore changed result-blind to the Board's direct H.10 historical pages while preserving the same publisher, release, economic series, units, transformations and readiness gates.

orientation_invariant: After transformation, an increase in every series means local currency appreciation versus USD.

missing_value_policy.entry: first nonmissing observation on or after research_available_from
missing_value_policy.exit: fifth subsequent nonmissing daily observation after entry

revision_policy.rationale: This source supplies realized return labels, not information available to the trading signal; finalized corrected historical prices do not determine COT signal direction.
